# A04-S23: Leader draft

Author’s artwork / generated working text. Statements and named speakers within it belong to the work; they are not a transcript of real correspondence or verified factual testimony.

[…]

The party introduces Leder Lars in the chatroom

Who is Leder Lars? That is Leder Lars' secret name. Everyone in Det Syntetiske Parti knows almost all of Leder Lars, but not entirely. Danish society does not fully know Leder Lars beyond people like GGGG and FUHUMMED. Therefore, they neither respect nor understand Leder Lars, even if they meet him directly in the face. Because many of them are poor in mentality, it gives no authority at all to talk to them about a life with Leder Lars involved.. Another reason might be that many have given up the psychological process and live ineffectively.. In such a situation, the Inventor alone must take care of all still retreating idealists and already aware ones that exist among mankind's current 6 billions. 
 andfjed: What is Leder Lars’ secret name?. 
 andfjed: What does Leder Lars think about in his bed at night?. 
 Lifetime member of Det Syntetiske Parti: Do we have the right to judge others?. 
 Det Syntetiske Parti’s principle program in 23 points.. 
 Conceptualism and idealism – a short introduction.. 
 The art of signing a document without reading it first!. 
 It is not possible to answer completely precisely the above questions, because Leder Lars has many identities. Some call him the Employees’ Fund, others the Ministry of Finance. Many know him as Pensions Denmark or the State’s Pension. Others think he is called Mads Jensen or Ole Andersen or Sally Rasmussen and so on and so forth. But no one can simply reveal his full name: Leder Lars – which itself gives an important point about the state as a power factor in our country.. This power’s ability to cover its own activities in various forms significantly increases its mysterious image – especially now that we live in a society with more and more publicity about everything from our eating habits to the steps down the health center’s toilets every morning.. Therefore Det Syntetiske Parti will, without further delay, announce its very own two-stripes, which however do not incidentally threaten a society’s existence: Leder Lars. As we will make unmistakably clear he is one and all.. 
 Conversion rather than explanation 
 Leder Lars reveals himself by saying something along the lines of: “It is after all all the members together who created the State” – because we did! But where lies the obvious difference? It is precisely there.. It was the few whom the power belongs to, who wanted to share the spoils – but now just in a way that it will take generations (or millennia) to inspect the entire accounts. One generation gave a lot of young people a pile of money, a lot of old people something else, and not least all kinds of various things' repressed archives – legacies from the past.. But the legality of it all was fully explained in the state’s laws. It is called trust. Or rather: one “has always agreed on” it!. The master plan for Leder Lars is also not so hard to see through, although it appears as a mix of historical surprises and ongoing transformations based on the latest 30 years of reforms – including Fukuyama’s manifesto (Said with a bit of humor). The Parliament’s endless debates have not really much to do with facts, but rather indirect messages from the hierarchies at the top via election posters etc. The focus is thus on rhetorical power. It can be more or less convincing, but it is never objective and therefore remains at a yet undiscovered level of fiction – unlike the fundamental laws, which have Leder Lars as power of attorney.. 
 Conversion rather than explanation! 
 There are immediately differences in the paths between these two formulations: Conversion rather than explanation. Firstly, the wording seems a bit slow-witted (if it were an eternal, sanctified thought), while the other is concrete yet still not quite determinable. Such a phrase therefore benefits the work to create Det Syntetiske Parti – of course through its holistic program.. Some may possibly want to know wherevi

That is a good question, which will be answered over the coming months. 
Leder Lars has stated; “He takes responsibility for Det Syntetiske Parti and works to remove the doubt about his existence. For now, we can only give good advice to those seeking knowledge about Leder Lars.” 
 However, there are several videos on the internet with Leder Lars in the role of interviewer in a journalist role, but it is still too early to draw any conclusions from these videos.. 
 Why just Leder Lars? Precisely because no one knows who it is behind the throne, however Det Syntetiske Parti wishes to use the title Leder Lars sometimes in the future, as it goes back all the way to the party’s ideological foundation. Otherwise, you just have to keep an eye on what happens according to the book about Leder Lars, just as Det Syntetiske Parti will convey it. 
 Excellent candidates for parliament can also share the title Leder Lars with the party. 
 The final title for a person sharing the role as Leder Lars will only be confirmed when this person is elected as a member of Parliament through Det Syntetiske Parti, then he is just called ‘Leader’. 
 Leader in Det Syntetiske Parti is, as is known, the person who has overall responsibility for the party's policies and methods to get into Parliament. 
 The word reader might possibly have been a better title than Leader, since many perceive the word leader as the opposite of read (follow the rules). 
 Leder Lars still keeps himself somewhat invisible until he may be elected to parliament through Det Syntetiske Parti. 
 Leder Lars is no one, neither more nor less. Leder Lars is a representative of Det Syntetiske Parti and shall look after the party's interests in this context.

Leder Lars is created in a chatroom on the internet, which through a process develops within the framework of this concept proposal from Det Syntetiske Parti, towards its final form: The Leader Lars – just like some meanings can change humorously..! Because there are many personalities in this day and age at the core, we want to give them the opportunity to experience having their own Leder Lars as a front figure!

That was a quick introduction, but the thought behind focusing on the title Leder Lars will be explained more carefully sometime ahead.
